title: FT report alleges Prince Group figure helped smuggle Nvidia chips to China
summary: A Financial Times report alleges that Hu Xiaowei, identified by the U.S. Treasury Department as the "number two" figure at Cambodia&\#x27;s Prince Group, helped smuggle Nvidia chips into China. Citing people familiar with the matter, the report describes a network involving shell companies, underground financing channels and private jets; Prince Group denied that Hu worked for it and said allegations about an illegal network and private-jet smuggling lacked factual basis. The report also cites trade data showing that Megaspeed&\#x27;s Malaysian subsidiary declared about $4.6 billion in imports between December 2024 and December 2025, with some chips allegedly reaching China&\#x27;s black market.
